_comment: Rank-3 commemorations mapped to an Orloff Common. Mapped by Josh's instruction 2026-10-01 ("map all rank-3 days") wherever a Common can fit without a feast-name blank. Deliberately UNMAPPED (8): Conception, Robe and Belt of the Theotokos, Mandylion, Procession of the Cross (Orloff's Lord/Theotokos/Cross Commons are templates with a '((name of the event))' blank that does not fit grammatically across feasts, plus readings and a prayer for the Emperor); Repose of Anna (no Common for the righteous); Nicaea Fathers+Nina (Orloff's chapter is only two partial sections); Leavetaking of the Entrance (no Common). AGES still covers some of these (data/menaion/ages/mapping.json).
